spec_match.rationale: Runs the production flow: connect, export 32 bytes under a user label/context (with live byte counters against the 255 limit), display verbatim results.

interactive.rationale: URL/label/context fields with byte counters, a run button, a timed step log, and an output region; everything is a real call.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises the end-to-end flow with honest error surfacing; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Branches for constructor throw, method missing, connection failure, and export rejection each carry distinct honest copy; counters flag over-255 inputs.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/<id> plus the exact spec anchor in see-also.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite applies; injected panel executed here.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified on headless Chromium 141 (predates Chrome 158, feature absent even behind --enable-experimental-web-platform-features) via Playwright 1.56 at desktop 1280x800 and mobile 360x740 DPR3 touch, driving every control; screenshots under /tmp/claude-0/agentB/shots/. Run stopped at the honest 'method missing' step before connecting; separately the connect path surfaced the real handshake failure. A resolved export (established session + 158 build) was not reachable from this environment.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.assert covers the primary contract and the explicit fallback branch; console output is intentional and prefixed.

design_system.rationale: Only CSS variables from public/styles.css; buttons overriding background also set color; AA pairs (text-charcoal/bg-stone, bg-ivory/text-black, accent-emerald-dark on paper).

accessibility.rationale: Native controls with labels, visible focus (verified first-Tab), caption+scope tables, aria-live polite result regions.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Both viewports clean; byte counters announce via the hint line.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify the supported path on a real Chrome 158 / Canary build
openQuestions.detail: This environment's Chromium 141 lacks the surface even behind --enable-experimental-web-platform-features, so only the honest-absent branch ran. On Chrome 158 (or Canary with the feature's runtime flag) verify: a resolved export on an established session: 32 bytes displayed, different context giving different bytes.

openQuestions.title: Verify the pooled-sessions-derive-different-keys claim when pooling is testable
openQuestions.detail: Chromium mixes the CONNECT stream ID into the exporter context so pooled sessions derive distinct keys. Needs two live pooled sessions against one server - out of reach without a real HTTP/3 endpoint; the claim is sourced from the chromestatus summary meanwhile.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native labelled controls with adequate touch targets and visible hints for constraints.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All controls are native button/select/input/radio elements with <label for> associations, min-height 44px, and inline constraint hints.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Landmarks, native semantics, accessible names, visible focus, and polite live regions for asynchronous state changes.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Content sits in main/header/footer landmarks; async results land in aria-live=polite output/status elements; tables carry caption plus th scope=col; first-Tab focus visibility verified in the browser.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce error/failure outcomes programmatically, not only visually.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Real API errors (name + message) are written into aria-live output regions and colour is never the only signal (text states the outcome).

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use intrinsically-sized grid/flex layouts (auto-fit + minmax) so panels reflow without horizontal overflow at narrow widths.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Control panels use grid-template-columns repeat(auto-fit, minmax()), tables are wrapped in overflow-x containers, and long tokens use overflow-wrap: anywhere; verified no horizontal overflow at 360px.

summary: The practical flow, real at every step it can be, and explicit about the one step this environment cannot reach.
